meaningOfStatus.planned: Spec and acceptance only; not implemented
meaningOfStatus.dev-prototype: Some development-only code or UI exists; not production-verified
meaningOfStatus.verified: End-to-end acceptance proven and evidence recorded

phases.P2: Project continuity and human knowledge workflow
phases.P5: Optional advanced capabilities after product use

features.title: Durable local notes
features.acceptance: A synthetic note survives reload, forced interruption after acknowledged commit, and exact local search on a supported client.

features.title: Encrypted client vault
features.acceptance: Ciphertext only is persisted; independent review verifies key lifecycle, nonce management, lock behavior, and tampering rejection.

features.title: Encrypted cross-device relay
features.acceptance: Three real devices converge through a private no-Docker relay under reordered, duplicated, and interrupted encrypted updates.

features.title: Local keyword search
features.acceptance: Unlocked client searches a 10k-note corpus with measured latency and no server-side plaintext index.

features.title: Tags and pinned records
features.acceptance: Tags remain portable and consistent across edits; pinning follows explicit, tested order without duplicating records.

features.title: Immutable revision history
features.acceptance: Every accepted edit creates a recoverable revision; restoring a version appends a new revision instead of deleting history.

features.title: Independent encrypted backup restore
features.acceptance: A fresh client restores an independently held encrypted snapshot and compares full record, attachment, and key-epoch checksums.

features.title: Non-destructive Standard Notes migration
features.acceptance: An isolated import reports unsupported formats and mismatches, round-trips supported records, and never deletes source data.

features.title: Universal capture inbox
features.acceptance: A titleless synthetic note can be captured without categorization; later adapters use the same validated submission contract.

features.title: Typed knowledge objects
features.acceptance: Notes, projects, and decisions use stable IDs; new kinds are versioned without breaking existing exported items.

features.title: Backlinks and stable relations
features.acceptance: Renaming or moving an item preserves incoming links, including cross-space permission checks and broken-target indicators.

features.title: Original-source ledger
features.acceptance: Imported material retains original URI, file hash, timestamps, authority label, and derived-record relationships.

features.title: Revocable scoped integration service
features.acceptance: An external identity cannot read outside its grant, cannot retrieve the vault key, and loses future operations when revoked.

features.title: GPT write-only contribution tool
features.acceptance: A real MCP tool can create submissions without exposing any read/list/search method, enforced by server authorization.

features.title: Encrypted attachments
features.acceptance: Attachment bytes and metadata are independently recoverable and encrypted, with bounded size and safe previews.

features.title: Portable export and import
features.acceptance: JSON/Markdown exports round-trip item identities, bodies, provenance, relations, and attachments; plaintext export requires consent.

features.title: Authenticated pairing and revocation
features.acceptance: A new device joins only after authenticated key exchange; revoked credentials cannot authorize future sync.

features.title: Truthful sync inspector
features.acceptance: Saved-local, relay-acknowledged, and peer-applied states are independently demonstrated under interrupted networks.

features.title: Android lifecycle and share-sheet bridge
features.acceptance: On real phone/tablet, force-stop recovery and foreground catch-up pass; share sheet capture preserves content without lost saves.

features.title: Optional local semantic retrieval
features.acceptance: Semantic indexes can be deleted and rebuilt from selected authorized items without endangering notes or requiring a cloud API.

features.title: Concurrent-edit semantic recovery
features.acceptance: Two offline clients editing one item converge or surface a recoverable conflict; no accepted edit silently disappears.

features.title: Lost-device and key recovery
features.acceptance: A simulated lost-device restore succeeds only with authorized recovery material; unrecoverable secrets are disclosed accurately.

features.title: Local operation and evidence log
features.acceptance: Every accepted revision records identity and action; a failed transaction produces no successful event receipt.

features.title: Peer-applied confirmation
features.acceptance: A receiving device cryptographically acknowledges applied revision before the sending UI labels it present on that device.

features.title: Contribution review inbox
features.acceptance: Synthetic write-only submissions have unique receipts, show origin, can be reviewed, and cannot retrieve existing items.

features.title: Project Resume Capsules
features.acceptance: A project opens to the latest recorded next action, blocker, repo reference, and evidence link without searching prior chats.

features.title: Evidence-State Labels
features.acceptance: Record states distinguish proposed, claimed, observed, verified and stale; verified requires a reference and remains manual.

features.title: Decision Memory
features.acceptance: A decision records rationale, alternatives and superseding links; discarded decisions are visible without becoming current authority.

features.title: Repository-Anchored Margin Notes
features.acceptance: An annotation retains an immutable commit/path/range anchor and warns when viewing an unrelated newer revision.

features.title: Incident Cards
features.acceptance: An incident preserves the original failure, reproduction, confirmed repair, and reusable regression proof in one record.

features.title: One-Tap Agent Handoff
features.acceptance: Only user-selected items become a portable, bounded task packet with constraints, evidence states and exact sources.

features.title: Note to GitHub Issue
features.acceptance: A previewed issue draft is published only to the named repository with explicit confirmation and idempotent receipt.

features.title: Outstanding Commitments
features.acceptance: A pending obligation has owner, expected outcome and review date without creating a full duplicate task system.

features.title: Interactive Runbook Cards
features.acceptance: A runbook lists steps, expected checks, stop conditions and rollback; execution remains manual unless separately authorized.

features.title: Continue on Another Device
features.acceptance: A second trusted device reopens the same project/item and scroll context only after authentic peer synchronization.

features.title: Deep Citation Anchors
features.acceptance: A citation stores the exact page, line or section when supported, with origin snapshot and stale-target detection.

features.title: Image Region Notes
features.acceptance: An annotation stays attached to normalized image coordinates across device sizes without modifying the source bytes.

features.title: Timecoded Media Notes
features.acceptance: Timestamp annotations open a compatible audio/video source near the selected time and survive export.

features.title: Evidence Freshness Rules
features.acceptance: A source-linked claim becomes needs-review on a configured expiry or source revision, not silently false/true.

features.title: Contradiction and Duplicate Review
features.acceptance: Potential duplicates and mismatches are presented with source provenance and never auto-merged or deleted.

features.title: Watch This Source
features.acceptance: An approved watcher submits only an authorized change receipt; disabling it leaves capture and search intact.

features.title: Project Reading Radar
features.acceptance: Selected source feeds appear in one project context without creating a compulsory general-purpose RSS reader.

features.title: What Changed Since I Was Here
features.acceptance: A project reopen displays revisions since last visit from actual recorded events, separating observations from inferred impact.

features.title: Remember This Later
features.acceptance: A selected note resurfaces at an explicit interval with skip/postpone controls and no compulsive notification loops.

features.title: Downstream Review Hints
features.acceptance: A changed source flags dependent notes for user review without silently rewriting authoritative material.

features.title: DEX//REACH Result Receipts
features.acceptance: A sanitized receipt links one verified job result to a project with no raw secrets, delegated terminal access, or invented success.

features.title: DexDictate Capture Route
features.acceptance: Only explicitly submitted transcribed text enters a destination inbox with origin and no shared dictation microphone permission.

features.title: Selective Git Publication
features.acceptance: A redacted diff for a named document is previewed and approved before a scoped commit or draft PR; private vault never mirrors wholesale.

features.title: Portable Offline Project Kits
features.acceptance: An authorized client packs selected encrypted records and attachments with a verifiable manifest and successful offline restore.

features.title: Quiet, Actionable Alerts
features.acceptance: A user-chosen condition produces a minimal authenticated alert, and no body/content leak or persistent spam occurs.
